chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Kinānī from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Regarding a pregnant woman whose husband has died, maintenance is to be spent on her from the wealth of her child who is in her womb.

key_terms.الْمُتَوَفَّى: the one whose husband has died
key_terms.وَلَدِهَا: her child, meaning the unborn child in this context

ai.seo_question: Who provides for a pregnant woman after her husband dies according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the maintenance of a pregnant widow. It states that her support is to be provided from the property of the unborn child she carries, establishing a ruling connected to family law and financial rights.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4789 - Muhammad ibn Al-Fudayl narrated from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"In the case of a pregnant woman whose husband has passed away, her expenses are to be provided from the wealth of the child she carries in her womb."
